item.title: ⚙️ MOHPER: Multi-Objective Hyperparameter Optimization for E-commerce
item.description:
Overview

MOHPER is a multi-objective hyperparameter optimization framework designed specifically for e-commerce retrieval systems. This project tackles the challenge of optimizing multiple business metrics simultaneously (CTR, CVR) without harming other guardrail metrics.

Key Achievements

  • Production Impact: Launched tuned parameters 5+ times on Search Result Page (SERP) and 3+ times on Category Product List Page (CPLP)
  • Business Metrics: Each A/B test targeted either CTR or CVR improvements without degrading other metrics
  • Publication: Accepted to CIKM'25 Applied Science Track (top conference on information retrieval)
  • Patent: Patent application filed
  • Team Expansion: Framework now expanded to AD domain and adopted as common stack for Search Team

Tech Stack

  • AutoML: Optuna, Ray Tune
  • Optimization: Evolutionary Strategies (ES)
  • Configuration: Hydra-core
  • Infrastructure: Existing search stack

item.title: 🗣️ Prompt-Aware Speech Scoring System for Second Language Learners
item.description:
Overview

Developed an end-to-end automatic speech scoring system for second language learners that addresses the cold-start problem by incorporating prompt (text and image) awareness. The system was successfully deployed to SANTA Say, a TOEIC Speaking practice app.

Key Achievements

  • Publication: Accepted to InterSpeech 2023 (top conference on audio & signal processing)
  • Production Deployment: Integrated into SANTA Say TOEIC Speaking App
  • Cold-Start Robustness: Achieved reliable performance even with limited training data for new prompts
  • Real-World Impact: Helping thousands of language learners improve their speaking skills

item.title: 🎙️ Emotional Text-to-Speech (TTS) System
item.description:
Overview

As Research Lead and COO at Humelo, I led the development of next-generation emotional Text-to-Speech systems that could convey nuanced emotions and expressions in synthesized speech. This project was funded by the Ministry of SMEs and startups.

Key Achievements

  • Government Grant: Secured TIPS R&D grant from Ministry of SMEs (S2644149)
  • Publications: Multiple papers accepted to ICASSP (top conference on audio & signal processing)
  • Multi-speaker: Developed systems supporting multiple voices and speaking styles
  • Emotional Control: Fine-grained control over emotional expression in synthesized speech

Technical Innovations

1. Factorized Hierarchical VAE

Developed multi-speaker and multi-domain emotional voice conversion using hierarchical variational autoencoders.

item.title: 🔊 Polyphonic Sound Event Detection with Transfer Learning
item.description:
Overview

Research on detecting multiple simultaneous sound events using convolutional bidirectional LSTMs and synthetic data-based transfer learning. This work addressed the challenge of learning from limited real-world audio data.

Key Innovation

Synthetic Data-Based Transfer Learning:

  • Generated synthetic audio data for pre-training
  • Transferred knowledge to real-world sound event detection
  • Achieved robust performance with limited labeled data

Technical Approach

  • Architecture: Convolutional Bidirectional LSTM
  • Data Augmentation: Synthetic audio generation
  • Transfer Learning: Pre-train on synthetic data, fine-tune on real data

Publication

Seokwon Jeong, *Jungbae Park, *Sang Wan Lee - “Polyphonic sound event detection using convolutional bidirectional LSTM and Synthetic data-based transfer learning” (ICASSP 2019)
